title: Stars Optimized
description: Stars Optimized Is A Great Modpack Made For Your Lower End Devices To Improve Your Fps And Stabilization.
body:
Stars Optimized is a Fabric performance modpack which will definitely help optimize the game. This is achieved by maximizing frames per second, reducing lag, speeding up chunk generation, increasing memory utilization and speeding up the responsiveness of the game without changing the overall vanilla experience.

### What Stars Optimized improves:

* Increases frame rate and stabilizes frame time.
* Faster chunk loading and generation.
* Uses less RAM.
* Increases networking performance.
* Makes rendering more efficient by eliminating redundancy and optimizing operations.
* Decreases game and loading screen startup time.
* Configurable and compatible with Fabric mods.

### Main optimization mods that make Stars Optimized work:

Lithium - Optimizes in-game logic such as entity ticking, physics, and other miscellaneous calculations.
ModernFix - Contains many bug fixes which enhance game performance and reduce memory usage.
FerriteCore - Optimizes the game to use less memory.
Krypton - Optimizes networking performance and packet handling.
ServerCore - Optimizes server performance for single-player use.
BadOptimizations - Provides further optimizations to the CPU and rendering.
Noisium - Speeds up world generation and noise computations.
C2ME - Multi-threaded chunk loading and generation.

### Mods that improve rendering and fps:

VulkanMod - Uses Vulkan or OpenGL to render the game instead of Java rendering, which can drastically improve performance on capable hardware.
ImmediatelyFast - Optimizes the GUI and rendering pipelines.
EntityCulling - Stops entities that are obstructed from being rendered.
Cull Leaves - Decreases the rendering overhead of leaf blocks.
BetterRenderDistance - Optimizes the performance of render distance.
ScalableLux - Improves lighting computations and performance.
Beryl - Optimized renderer with additional graphics improvements.

### Mods for added convenience and utility:

Zoomify - Makes zooming in and out feel incredibly smooth.
FPS Display - Shows in-game FPS and performance information.
Mod Menu - Simple way to access installed mods and their configurations.

### Libraries Stars Optimized requires to function:

Fabric API
Fabric Language Kotlin
Cloth Config
YACL
Placeholder API
